frozen_body: W04e defines Osterwalder-Schrader conjugation on imaginary-time test functions by Theta f(tau)=conjugate(f(-tau)), with Theta an antilinear involution, and defines the OS Hermitian form by <f,g>_OS=S2(Theta f,g).

reconstruction.formula: Theta = conjugation o time-reflection; OS(f,g)=S2(Theta f,g)

guards: Pointwise tau evaluation is abstracted at the frozen OS boundary; the exact invariant reflection/conjugation composition is represented.
